body:

# 4. Deliverables

# 5. Timeline
Working days are counted from the day the deposit arrives, Monday to Friday, excluding Nigerian public holidays.

{{timeline}}

The timeline moves by the same number of days for any delay on the Client's side, or while work is paused for late payment.

# 6. Client responsibilities
The Client provides, in good time:

{{responsibilities}}

# 7. Payment schedule
The total price is {{total}}, paid in {{currency}}.

{{payment}}

Prices do not include third-party costs (hosting, domains, paid services or licences). The Client pays these directly or reimburses them at cost after approving them in writing.

# 8. Acceptance
The work is finished when:

{{acceptance}}

The Developer tells the Client when each deliverable is ready for review. The Client gets two rounds of revisions on each deliverable, requested within 7 days of it being ready. A deliverable with no written feedback within 7 days counts as accepted. When everything is accepted, the balance invoice is issued.

# 9. Change orders
Anything new or different from this agreement is a change. The Client asks for it in writing (email or WhatsApp is fine). The Developer replies in writing with the price and the effect on the timeline. Work on the change starts only after the Client approves it in writing, and it is invoiced separately.

# 10. General terms
Ownership. Once the Client has paid in full, the Client owns the final deliverables made for this project, including the source code written for it. The Developer keeps the tools, libraries and general know-how used to build it, and grants the Client a permanent, non-exclusive licence to use them as part of the deliverables. Open-source components stay under their own licences. The Developer may show the finished work in a portfolio, without confidential information, unless the Client asks in writing for it not to be shown.

Accounts and access. Accounts for third-party services (domain, hosting, payments, email and similar) are opened in the Client's name, or transferred to the Client at handover. The Developer is given the access the work needs and removes it, or has it removed, when the project ends.

Confidentiality. Each party keeps the other's non-public information confidential and uses it only for this project. This continues after the agreement ends.

Warranty. The Developer fixes, at no charge, defects in the delivered work reported within 30 days of acceptance. This does not cover changes made by anyone else, new features, or problems caused by third-party services.

Liability. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential losses. The Developer's total liability under this agreement is limited to the amount the Client has paid under it.

Ending the agreement. Either party may end this agreement with 14 days' written notice. The Client pays for all work done up to the end date and receives that work once it is paid for. Ownership, confidentiality and liability continue after the agreement ends.

Law and signatures. This agreement, with the proposal it is part of, is the whole agreement between the parties on this project. Changes must be in writing and agreed by both. It is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, and the parties will first try to settle any dispute by talking it through in good faith. Both parties agree that signing electronically on this page is as binding as signing on paper.
